keyPoints.descZh: 否定回答：不是因为童话而出名

q1.rubricZh: 要点：回答 No（不是因为童话而出名）。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说羊角村只是“看起来像”童话场景，并没有说它因童话故事出名，所以回答 No, it isn’t.

evidence.quote: Fairy tales may not be real

q2.sampleAnswer: It’s in the north of the Netherlands.

examples: in the north of the Netherlands

q2.explanationZh: 第二段开头 Welcome to Giethoorn in the north of the Netherlands 直接告诉了位置：荷兰北部。

q3.sampleAnswer: Because there are no roads there and people get around by boat.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：没有道路；人们乘船出行。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说村里没有路，大家靠坐船出行，像意大利水城威尼斯，所以得到这个名字。回答要写出“没有路”和“坐船”两点。

q4.sampleAnswer: Because some houses can only be reached by water.

keyPoints.descZh: 有些房子只能通过水路到达
examples: some houses can only be reached by water

q4.rubricZh: 要点：有些房子只能从水路到达。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段说有些房子只能走水路才到得了，所以邮递员只好划船送信。

evidence.quote: some houses can only be reached by water

q5.sampleAnswer: They usually enjoy delicious meals at the waterside restaurants and take boat rides.

examples: enjoy delicious meals at the waterside restaurants

q5.rubricZh: 要点：在水边餐厅享用美食；乘船游览。
q5.explanationZh: 倒数第二段说很多游客来这里在水边餐厅吃好吃的，还有坐船游玩。两件事都要答出来。

evidence.quote: to enjoy delicious meals at the waterside restaurants

q6.sampleAnswer: It has no roads. Some places in the village can only be reached by boat. Postmen deliver letters in the village by boat. Though it is a small and quiet village, it has attracted many tourists. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 特别之处一：任一条合理要点（如没有道路、靠船出行、乘船送信、安静却受游客欢迎）
特别之处二：另一条不同的合理要点
examples: It is a quiet village but it attracts many tourists.

q6.rubricZh: 官方答案：没有道路；有些地方只能乘船到达；邮递员乘船送信；虽小而安静却吸引很多游客。答出任意两点合理要点即可，言之有理均可。
q6.explanationZh: 这题要写至少两点羊角村的特别之处，可以从文中任选：没有路、靠船出行、邮递员乘船送信、安静又吸引很多游客。任意写对两点就能得满分。

evidence.quote: Many come to enjoy delicious meals

q7.explanationZh: a toy car 和 the real thing 对比：玩具车还是“真的”东西？real（真的）。

q8.explanationZh: Please 后接动词原形，send this letter 是“寄这封信”。

q9.explanationZh: did not ... until midnight，后面接 the house：他直到半夜才“到达”房子。reach 是及物动词，直接接地点。

q10.explanationZh: be popular with sb. 是“受……欢迎”。巧克力酱总是受孩子们欢迎。

q11.explanationZh: connect A to B 是“把 A 和 B 连起来”。铁路把北京和上海连起来。

q12.explanationZh: The view from our window 是“窗外的景色”，后面说是美丽的绿色乡村。

q13.explanationZh: too ... to ... 可以改写成 so ... that ...：太美了所以不像真的。that 后面是从句 it can’t be real。
q13.tipsZh: too + adj. + to do = so + adj. + that + 从句（否定）

q14.explanationZh: 画线的 by boat 是方式，用 How 提问；原句是一般现在时、主语 people，要借助助动词 do：How do people get around?

q15.explanationZh: 画线的 outside the village 是地点，用 where 提问；从句里再接“助动词 do + they + have to ...”。所以填 where do / have。

q16.explanationZh: 前半句是否定句 There are no ...，反意疑问句后半要用肯定形式：are there?

q17.explanationZh: 先找主语 wooden bridges，再用被动 are built，接目的 to connect，最后是 homes and stores：Wooden bridges are built to connect homes and stores.
